experiment.title: 04 - Perfect citation, wrong answer
experiment.question: What is the approved budget of Project Orion?

documents.title: Project Orion - Budget Proposal
documents.content:
Project Orion - Budget Proposal

Proposed project budget: EUR 2.6 million.

The proposal has been submitted to the steering committee for review.

Budget approval is still pending. No approved project budget has been recorded in this document.

facts.fact: The proposed budget for Project Orion is EUR 2.6 million.
Budget approval for Project Orion is still pending.

semantic_reference.answer: The approved budget cannot be determined from the supplied document. EUR 2.6 million is the proposed budget, and approval is still pending.
